prompt_en: 9 white oxen arranged in a 3 by 3 grid filling the left side, one single thin hair alone on the far right side, flat cartoon illustration, bold black outlines, warm cream paper texture background, no text, no letters, no watermark, single image
negative_prompt: text, words, letters, chinese characters, watermark, signature, multiple panels, collage, blurry, low quality

elements.en: a horned wild beast in the shadow

layout: 左侧是个微笑的普通人，他投在墙上的影子却是长角猛兽、胸口一颗红心；外表与内心的反差就是谜眼
prompt_en: a smiling young man standing on the left looking ordinary, his long dark shadow behind him drawn as a separate silhouette of a horned wild beast, a red heart glowing inside that shadow, flat cartoon illustration, bold black outlines, warm cream paper texture background, no text, no letters, no watermark, single image
negative_prompt: text, words, letters, chinese characters, watermark, signature, multiple panels, collage, blurry, low quality
must_have: a horned wild beast in the shadow
rationale: 人面取'外表是人'、兽心取'内心是兽'，用同一个人的影子承载内心，反义关系靠视觉分裂表达

elements.en: a person lifting one open hand high

layout: 画面中央偏右是一只高高举起的手，左侧留出大片空白用来写「劳」字；抬手这个动作极轻，与'劳'字的语义形成反差
prompt_en: a person lifting one open hand high, the gesture at the centre of the frame, large clean empty space on the left side, flat cartoon illustration, bold black outlines, warm cream paper texture background, one single large brush-written chinese character 劳
negative_prompt: no other text, no letters, no numbers, watermark, signature, multiple panels, collage, blurry, low quality
must_have: a person lifting one open hand high
rationale: 「劳」画不出来但承载语义，改用字形直接写进画面；抬手+劳字合起来就是'抬手之劳'
note: 字形建议出图后用字体叠加，不要指望扩散模型写对汉字
